name: besieged-slash-class-bonus-3-units-discount
notes: Besieged Slash (activationCostModifierAbilities["Dkq7QnrGJI:0"], GeneratedMacroCode.php) costs 2 less (3 -> 1 reserve) when [Class Bonus] is active (player's champion is WARRIOR) AND the opponent controls 3+ ALLY/CHAMPION units. Player 2 is patched to a WARRIOR champion (Lorraine, Wandering Warrior) for the class bonus; player 1 gets 2 extra Dungeon Guide allies seeded onto their field, which combined with their own already-present champion brings their unit count to exactly 3. Same real attack-card-activation shape as heavy-swing-class-bonus-discount: P1 passes turn 1 (Rule 1.h forbids the opening player from activating ATTACK cards turn 1), then P2 activates Besieged Slash on their own turn 1, paying only 1 rep of the reserve decision (not 3) before the mandatory attack-card target selection.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] As long as an opponent controls three or more units, this card costs 2 less to activate.
